data.one_liner: Network logger with user interface to inspect traffic logs and Dio interceptor.
data.what_it_does: Network logger with a well-designed user interface to inspect network traffic logs. It includes a Dio interceptor and an overlay button to easily view HTTP traffic on a GUI.
use_when: You are using Dio for networking and need a visual way to inspect traffic logs.
You want an easy overlay button to access network logs during development.
avoid_when: You are not using Dio as your HTTP client.
You do not need a visual UI for network inspection.
strengths: Includes a Dio interceptor for quick setup.
Comes with a draggable overlay button and UI for inspecting logs.
Supports copying body to clipboard and selectable fields.
weaknesses: Only includes a Dio interceptor currently.
Not documented for non-Dio HTTP clients.
data.setup_notes: Add the DioNetworkLogger interceptor to your Dio client and attach NetworkLoggerOverlay to your context in initState.

alternatives.name: pretty_dio_logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer console-based pretty logging for Dio requests instead of an in-app visual UI.

alternatives.name: talker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a comprehensive logging and error handling solution with network inspection capabilities.
